name: zscaler-guard
description: Keeps what corporate DLP (Zscaler) blocks out of what Claude Code sends: redacts cards, national IDs, bank numbers, keys and tokens, withholds whole datasets or restricted content, and recognises the 403 'Internet Security by Zscaler' block. Method adapted from pdpa-thai (boombignose-mods, MIT). Local only; no network calls of its own.

bulkThreshold.title: Bulk threshold
bulkThreshold.description: Withhold a whole block (tool output, @file, context) that holds at least this many sensitive values, as a dataset. 0 turns it off.

withholdMedia.title: Withhold images and documents
withholdMedia.description: Replace image and PDF blocks with a note before sending (for DLP policies that OCR images).

customRedact.title: Extra value patterns to redact
customRedact.description: Regular expressions separated by ;; for values your DLP policy blocks (e.g. contract or customer ID formats). /body/flags keeps flags i m s u.

customWithhold.title: Restricted-content patterns
customWithhold.description: Regular expressions separated by ;; for content that must not be sent at all (e.g. classification labels from your data policy). A matching block is withheld whole, never trimmed.
